meta.title: Bayele — Nano-influence & Mobile Money Escrow
meta.description: The escrow marketplace where creators and brands grow together in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Gabon.

announce: Launch — create your free creator profile and be among the first proposed to brands.

hero.title: Where creators and brands grow together
hero.subtitle: Brands submit a brief and pay only on proof. Creators post and get paid via Mobile Money.

creator.title: Your audience is worth money
creator.body: Even your WhatsApp status counts. Create a free profile, get campaigns, withdraw from 1,000 FCFA.
creator.micro: The campaign money is locked before you post.

brand.title: A brief, not a search
brand.body: Budget, country, deliverables: describe your campaign, and Bayele and its partners propose the right creators.
brand.micro: Held in escrow: you pay only on proof.

hero.partnerLink: Agency or talent manager? Become a partner

creator.title: Keep building your media kit
creator.body: The more complete your profile, the more Bayele puts you forward to brands.

business.title: Ready for your next campaign?
business.body: Describe your brief: we propose matching creators, held in escrow.

partner.title: Your partner space
partner.body: Run your retainers and your clients' campaigns.

trust.escrowBody: The budget is locked at launch. The creator is paid as soon as proof of delivery is validated.
trust.momoBody: Withdraw to MTN, Orange Money or Wave, no hidden fees, from 1,000 FCFA.
trust.ohadaBody: Tax-deductible invoices with NIU/NCC for SMEs and agencies, via SokoClick.

steps.title: The budget is locked
steps.body: The brand funds the campaign. Funds move into escrow — untouchable on both sides.

steps.title: The creator posts
steps.body: Content published (WhatsApp status, TikTok…), proof submitted. A Gemini score prioritizes human review.

steps.title: Instant payout
steps.body: Once validated, funds are released to MTN, Orange Money or Wave.

brandsSteps.title: Submit your brief
brandsSteps.body: Budget, category, country and deliverables: tell us what your brand needs.

brandsSteps.title: Bayele selects the creators
brandsSteps.body: We and our partners propose the profiles that fit your campaign.

brandsSteps.title: Pay on proof
brandsSteps.body: The budget stays in escrow and is only released once the post is proven.

creatorsSteps.title: Create your profile
creatorsSteps.body: Your networks, audience and categories: your showcase for brands.

creatorsSteps.title: Get campaigns
creatorsSteps.body: Apply to campaigns or receive invitations that match your content.

creatorsSteps.title: Get paid
creatorsSteps.body: Mobile Money payout as soon as your proof is approved — no chasing payments.

profileKit.heading: Your profile is your media kit
profileKit.body: Every Bayele profile has its own link. Share it on WhatsApp, TikTok or Instagram to show brands your audience and networks — the more complete it is, the more campaigns you get.
bullets: One link to share, no file to send
Audience and networks kept up to date

partner.heading: Become a Bayele Partner
partner.body: Talent managers, agencies, marketing consultants: manage your creators and campaigns on Bayele. We provide the platform, payments, invoicing and tracking; you bring the relationships and the know-how.

directory.consultantsSubtitle: Agencies and talent managers to run your campaigns

finalCta.title: Ready to grow with creators?
finalCta.subtitle: Submit your brief or create your profile: Bayele handles the matching and secures every payment.

directoryPage.creatorsLede: Browse verified nano-creators. Filter by country and category.
directoryPage.consultantsLede: Agencies, talent managers and media strategists to design and run your campaigns.

curated.title: Bayele introduces you to creators
curated.body: During our launch, the creator directory isn't public. Describe your campaign: Bayele and its partners propose the creators who fit your brief.
curated.brandBody: Submit your brief, get a shortlist of creators.
curated.creatorBody: Create your profile to be proposed to brands.
curated.appBody: During launch, the creator directory isn't self-serve. Submit a campaign brief: Bayele proposes matching creators and you approve them before any payment.
